charts.title: cell-sorting-spatial-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the ~600 Monte Carlo step sorting run: a mixed 8x8 checkerboard of two cell types (64 cells, 32/32), each drawn in a distinct type color, demixes under differential adhesion alone -- like cells cluster and the heterotypic boundary between the two types collapses into two consolidated domains, while the clump stays cohesive (it does not dissolve into medium). Complementarity made spatial: cells stay adjacent where their adhesion preferences are complementary. Re-baked over the same run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: cell-sorting-metrics
charts.caption: Interactive Plotly panel of the same sorting run, synced to the GIF's time axis: the heterotypic-interface fraction (the headline demixing signal, ~0.64 -> ~0.06) plotted together with the total live-cell pixel count (the cohesion guard, held ~1530). The two traces together are the load-bearing evidence -- the fraction dropping while the pixels hold is what distinguishes a real sort from a dissolved clump. Interactive: hover for exact per-tick values.

charts.title: condensate-cahn-hilliard-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the 10000-step Cahn-Hilliard run: a 64x64 composition field seeded with near-critical noise undergoes spinodal decomposition, resolving from a uniform grey haze into two distinct phases separated by a sharp, emergent interface -- the diffuse-interface analogue of a condensate droplet forming out of a well-mixed medium, mass-conserved throughout. An independent demonstration, not coupled to the sorting cells. Re-baked over the same run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: condensate-metrics
charts.caption: Interactive Plotly panel of the same condensate run, synced to the GIF's time axis: the field variance phi_var rising from ~7e-5 toward the coexistence variance ~0.38 as the two phases form -- the phase-separation order parameter made directly visible. Interactive: hover for exact per-step values.
